T863 (protocol compliance race, spec + judge) — Step 0 completed on measured evidence; Steps 1-2 (the eight-entrant race) explicitly NOT RUN; Step 3 (control arm) cited from T862's existing evidence rather than re-run live. Full narrative and tables in docs/infra/races/protocol-compliance.md; this file summarizes.

PRECONDITIONS CHECKED FIRST. T862 (glm-5.2, done, pass-with-findings) and T891 (glm-5.2, done, pass-with-findings) were both landed before this task started, as the brief required. Re-ran tools/regression-lane-telemetry-parity.sh (T891's regression): all arms PASS.

STEP 0 — measured via `bin/subagent --dry-run` for all eight canonical models (claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, glm-5.2, minimax-m3, kimi-k2.7, ox-alpha), no live model calls, no cost, no kanban mutation. RESULT: the injected prompt is byte-identical across all eight (mod the necessarily-unique nonce and target path). The constructed argv is NOT identical beyond provider/model name: ollama lacks --mode json (deepseek and pi/ox-alpha have it); claude carries --output-format json + a named meter_reason instead of --session, plus a claude-only --allowedTools flag; claude never receives --thinking. Each difference is a documented, deliberate response to a real per-provider capability gap (T891's verdict_note), not an arbitrary harness inconsistency — but it still fails the brief's literal Step 0 criterion ('differs only in provider and model name'). CONCLUSION: equal treatment does not hold byte-for-byte; per the brief's own acceptance clause ('or an explicit refusal to run'), this task refuses to dispatch the eight entrants.

WHY REFUSED, BEYOND STEP 0: this task was claimed by a leaf worker with no dispatch authority for this brief, and ox-alpha carries appetite=spend (src/managent/main.zig:537) — real cost against a comparison whose own precondition doesn't hold would spend money to produce a number the brief itself says not to trust.

THE PART THAT ACTUALLY MATTERS: splitting the eight by whether --mode json is present (the flag D085 showed causes JSON-echo to inflate the nonce check toward a false PASS, confirmed by T862 regression arm H on the real verify_dispatch code path): echo-confounded = deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, ox-alpha (3 of 8); not confounded = glm-5.2, minimax-m3, kimi-k2.7 (no JSON mode at all), claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5 (--output-format json wraps only the result, does not echo the conversation) — 5 of 8, for two different reasons. A pooled nonce column across all eight would misrepresent three entrants' reliability relative to the other five.

NEW RISK SURFACED (not in T862 or T891's findings): T891 fixed ox-alpha's observability by adding --mode json + --session to its lane (previously neither existed; T891 called it 'no stdout liveness stream at all'). That same flag change moves ox-alpha INTO the echo-confounded group for the nonce metric specifically — the observability fix and the compliance-measurement confound pull opposite ways on one flag. Needs a decision (accept ox-alpha's nonce reads as confounded like deepseek's, or move dispatch_verify.py's nonce_ok off raw stdout) before any future race scores ox-alpha's nonce column.

STEP 3 (control arm) — not re-run live; cited from T862's regression arm H, which already ran the equivalent synthetic controlled comparison on the real verify_dispatch code path and found identical (non-complying) model behaviour scored PASS under --mode json and FAIL without it. Direction stated precisely: JSON-echo can only produce a false PASS, never a false FAIL, because it can only ADD text (the echoed prompt) to stdout, never remove genuine model output. This asymmetry is load-bearing for the next section.

THE FOUR RECORDED INSTANCES — identified by counting verified=fail lines per model in docs/infra/model-perf.md (re-measured 2026-08-25, stable across a concurrent edit to that file mid-task): ox-alpha has exactly four (T848 logged twice, T849, T860) — the only model at that count, matching the brief's 'one model has four recorded instances' claim.

DISPOSITION: T848 and T849 (both fail=row, both dated 2026-08-24 before T862 landed at 14:35:18Z, both later completed successfully under other models — deepseek-v4-pro and glm-5.2 respectively) are RETRACTED as a false attribution: T862's findings confirm the runner's auto-close net never fired for ANY bin/subagent-dispatched lane (gated on args.task_id, which is None when identity travels on MANAGENT_TASK_ID + --arbiter-id instead) — a universal, now-fixed harness defect, not ox-alpha-specific behavior. T860 (fail=nonce; bin/managent show T860: exit 0 after 1325.4s, 27,743-byte deliverable committed, nonce absent from stdout, closed on evidence by the seat) ran while the pi/openrouter lane had NEITHER --mode json NOR --session — so the D085 echo mechanism (which requires --mode json) cannot explain it; no echo channel existed to inflate a false PASS, and echo has no mechanism for a false FAIL. This instance is UNSETTLED, not confirmed and not retracted: T891 separately found this lane had 'no stdout liveness stream at all,' a capture-completeness question distinct from JSON-echo, which this task did not test. The seat's original framing at close time (docs/infra/managent/tasks.json T860 verdict_note: 'recorded as a protocol-observability failure, not a model failure') remains the more honest available posture.

PLAIN STATEMENT (per acceptance criterion): three of the four recorded instances (the close-skips) are retracted as a confirmed, now-fixed harness defect; the fourth (the nonce-skip) stands unresolved pending a capture-completeness test this task did not run.

STEP 4 — no ledger cells written for any of the eight under task type protocol, since no entrant ran. The disposition above is this row's reading of the four existing ox-alpha cells in docs/infra/model-perf.md (append-only log, not edited by this task): three untrusted-as-attributed, one open.

WHAT WOULD BE NEEDED to run Steps 1-2 for real: (1) a dispatcher with authority to spend against ox-alpha's appetite=spend budget and standing authorization for 16 live entrant calls, outside this leaf task's scope; (2) a nonce-verification channel that does not degrade under --mode json, or an explicit per-entrant asymmetry note rather than a pooled column; (3) a resolution of ox-alpha's newly-introduced echo exposure before its nonce column is compared to ollama's or claude's.
